subject: Re: MGDT kickoff — decision ahead of the June run
body:
Team,

Decision from this morning's pre-run review. The dress rehearsal got the loader to 91% utilization — good but not the 95% bar. Rather than gamble the reserved week, we're cutting scope:

1. The June run trains the large config plus ONE replication of the mid point. The online-RL comparison arm is dropped; the open-source paper already establishes that offline decision transformers scale better, and we don't need to re-prove it on our dime.
2. Yara's fine-tuning recipe ships with the medium checkpoint first; the large-checkpoint version follows after the run.

That keeps us comfortably inside the week and protects the scaling-curve deliverable for the H1 readout on 06-18. Wanjiru, please freeze the loader config by Friday.

Thanks all — tight but doable.

Ulla
